description: Nautobot: the network source of truth and automation platform (Jobs, GraphQL, Git-backed data), with Celery and the bundled PostgreSQL and Valkey. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from the release wheel, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

mox: a modern full-featured mail server (SMTP with SPF/DKIM/DMARC/MTA-STS, IMAP4, webmail, admin and account web UIs). Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
